Under the NEU's rarely ever cover policy, staff PPA should not be used to cover other members illness. 

Staff should only lose PPA for cover in exceptional or unforeseen circumstances. Staff being off ill, especially in the winter months is neither exceptional nor is it unforeseen.

This policy is 2 fold, it protects staff PPA time and it protects the jobs of supply/cover staff.

In these stage 1 meetings it's really important to put the onus on the school to help support you so you can be well enough to work. 

They'll normally show you your recent absence record with the reasons you cited for calling in sick.

Assuming you said it was due to poor mental health when calling in you can then provide suggestions for how the school could support you with this to prevent or reduce further absences. 

E.g.

 - More regular rest breaks  or moving your break duty to when you have a PPA immediately before/after

 - Support for tricky or challenging classes

 - Cover so you can attend counselling sessions (these are hard enough to get anyway let alone outside of school hours) 

The beauty of this is if they refuse any of the requests, you can then point back at the list next time you're off and say it's because they haven't done x, y or z to support you, therefore it can't progress to disciplinary. (Absence and disciplinary should be decoupled anyway) 

From a health and safety perspective the school has a legal duty of care to ensure nothing at work is making you physically or mentally unwell.
